rationale: Ground truth here is essentially empty substance (an LGTM plus an off-diff ask to spin out a VoxCPM2 regression fix into a separate PR); neither candidate mentions VoxCPM2, so recall is 0 for both. Both independently converge on the same well-grounded mechanism (deploy seed -> tts_local_seed -> per-row generator -> scalar multinomial cliff) and both raise the same core points (confirm red AMD/NPU lanes are pre-existing, add a tombstone comment so the seed doesn't silently return, add a regression-guard test) with concrete file:line citations, giving both high precision. Y edges ahead on actionability by shipping ready-to-paste artifacts (full YAML comment text, full pytest function) rather than describing the fix, and adds one extra grounded, non-redundant finding (the PR body understates that this also re-enables vLLM's own seeded-sampler fast paths) plus a cheap follow-up suggestion, making it marginally more complete and useful without sacrificing grounding.
